title: Fast parser versus completed batch
brief: Our acceptance target is 500 receipts fully available in the review service within five minutes of dropping a batch into the watched folder. Every receipt must have one correct result linked to its original file; retries must not create duplicate review items. Someone proposed selecting the fastest parser from the microbenchmark. Compare viable whole configurations and recommend a direction, stating what remains unproven. Give the smallest decisive experiment. The supplied fictional measurements and interface notes are all we currently have; no full 500-receipt run has occurred.
